title: The Karthian Flood Myth
subtitle: As told on the night docks
summary: A dockside tale of a city that drowned twice.
content:
Old harbor crews say there was a city called Karth beneath the ruins, and that the sea took it twice: once in water, once in silence.

- It is told only at the change of the tide
- It is never told twice in one night

Some Expeditioners claim the inscriptions found in [[g-21]] tell the same story.
